newsitem.title: GREECE: Natl Mortgage issues equity-linked drachma note.
newsitem.headline: Natl Mortgage issues equity-linked drachma note.

text.p: National Mortgage Bank of Greece is issuing a one-year 3.0 percent drachma equity-linked note based on a basket of six Athens stock exchange blue-chip stocks, sources at the issuer told Reuters.
Sigma Securities is the arranger of the issue with NIBID acting as co-arranger.
PLACEMENT AGENTS ING BARINGS FINANCIAL PRODUCTS
DISCOUNT OPTION AFTER SIX MONTHS FROM ISSUE DATE
ISSUE PRICE TO BE DEFINED AT ISSUE DATE
The stock basket includes six stocks, all large caps with good marketability. The respective basket weights have as follows:
The basket has historically outperformed the benchmark general share index.

Along with the 3.0 percent coupon -- the capital guarantee feature of the instrument -- investors may benefit by the stock basket's upside potential as they will reap 50 percent of its return with no cap.

Moreover, the note will offer an innovative lock-in facility for predetermined returns. Put differently, investors will have the option upon purchase to pick among the following four lock-in thresholds: open (no cap), 15, 20 and 25 percent.
Sources said the note is a "capital-guaranteed-plus-coupon product" as investors will not experience losses in case the stock basket turns south.
The note is designed for the conservative investor who would like to tap the stock market's high returns without taking on the risk associated with direct investment in equities.
Another attractive feature is the interest rate downtrend in Greece which is expected to bring yields down to single digits.
